title: The crow eats; someone else is blamed
odia: କଥାର ମଞ୍ଜି, କୁଆ ଧାନ ଖାଏ ବୋହୁକୁ ଗଞ୍ଜି
literal_meaning: The kernel of the matter: the crow eats the paddy, but the daughter-in-law is scolded.
explanation: Blame falls on someone other than the one responsible. The contrast exposes how unfair that is.
meaning_odia: ଦୋଷ କରୁଛି ଜଣେ, ଗାଳି ଶୁଣୁଛି ଆଉ ଜଣେ। ପ୍ରକୃତ କାରଣ ନଦେଖି ଅନ୍ୟ ଉପରେ ଦୋଷ ଲଦିବାର ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ଏଥିରେ ଧରାପଡ଼େ।
usage_example: A shared file disappears because of a system fault, but a new colleague is blamed before anyone checks. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The household scene names a daughter-in-law as the target of blame. It is not a claim about every family or an endorsement of blaming women.
